decisions.reason: As a core component with stable own-page presence, its option value remains high and keeping costs are low, so it is retained while uncertainty resolves.
Its move from a mention to a dedicated page signals increasing confidence and commitment, making early abandonment unlikely.
The step down from dedicated page to mention suggests weaker-than-expected prospects, but the option is still inexpensive to hold pending further evidence.
Only being mentioned indicates limited investment, but the product remains a low-cost option in the core shower area and is kept for flexibility.
Strong launch and home-page placement reveal substantial commitment and likely value, so the firm maintains this option.
As a peripheral, only-mentioned product, its strategic fit and value are less clear, yet its low keeping cost still favors holding the option for now.
